items.known: CKV_AWS_44 Ensure Neptune storage is securely encrypted (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Set `storage_encrypted = true` and optionally specify a KMS key via `kms_key_arn` to use a customer-managed key instead of the default AWS-managed key.

items.known: CKV_AWS_101 Ensure Neptune logging is enabled (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Add an `enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["audit"]` attribute to the `aws_neptune_cluster` resource to stream audit logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.

items.known: CKV_AWS_347 Ensure Neptune is encrypted by KMS using a customer managed Key (CMK) (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.issue: No KMS Customer-Managed Key (CMK) Specified for Encryption
items.remediation: Add `kms_key_arn = aws_kms_key.<your_key>.arn` alongside `storage_encrypted = true` to encrypt the cluster with a customer-managed KMS key.

scores.reason: Setting storage_encrypted = true is the correct fix; kms_key_arn is a valid optional addition.
enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["audit"] is the attribute and value that satisfies CKV_AWS_101.
kms_key_arn pointing to an aws_kms_key together with storage_encrypted = true satisfies the CMK check.
